observations: White and grey Brother DCP-9017CDW multifunction printer.
The model name 'DCP-9017CDW' is clearly printed on the front panel in photo 1.
The device has a touchscreen display and a paper output tray.
The top surface shows some dust and minor scuffs.
The power indicator light is visible but not clearly lit in the photos.

claims.claim: Low page count, under 20,000 copies. New drum and toner just fitted, no paper jam.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The printer may not power on or the touchscreen may be unresponsive.
risks.proof: A video showing the printer powering on and navigating the touchscreen menu.

risks.risk: The internal toner cartridge may be empty or the drum may be near the end of its life.
risks.proof: A photo of the toner level indicator on the touchscreen or a printed page showing the remaining toner.
risks.if_unproven: as needing a new toner cartridge

risks.risk: The paper feed mechanism may have internal jams or misfeeds.
risks.proof: A video of the printer successfully printing a test page and feeding a blank sheet.
risks.if_unproven: as having a paper feed issue

proof_requests: Video of the printer powering on and the touchscreen working.
Photo of the toner level screen.
Video of the printer printing a test page.
response.reason: The model is clearly identified from the photos, so it can be priced at its worst case as a non-working unit.
